_comment: Copy to pcsuite.json (git-ignored) or $HOME/.config/pcsuite/config.json, then fill in your own pairing identity. Every field can also be set via env (PCSUITE_MODE, PCSUITE_OPEN_ID, PCSUITE_PC_MAC, PCSUITE_ACCOUNT, PCSUITE_DEVICE_NAME, PCSUITE_SEED), which overrides the file.
_comment_mode: "serverless" (default) never contacts any server. "vivo_account" enables the connection-center registration in docs/VIVO_ACCOUNT_LOGIN.md; sign in with `pcsuite cloud login`, which stores the token in ~/.config/pcsuite/account.json (0600) — not here. Anything unrecognised means serverless.
